title: agent-regression golden case
description: One frozen production-derived task for before/after replay against an agent stack.

case_id.description: Stable identifier; production failures keep the ticket/trace id.

origin.description: Goldens grow from real work; synthetic allowed for coverage gaps, marked.

input.description: The exact task/request given to the agent, frozen.

initial_state.description: Fixed starting state: file tree seed, env vars, profile seed. Same across runs.

fixtures.description: Recorded tool responses keyed by call signature: replay must not hit live services.

allowed_tools.description: Tool allowlist for the run; absent = default toolset.

kind.description: Deterministic kinds gate; required_fact/rubric_1_5 are judged (review-only by default).

statement.description: The behavior asserted, in one sentence a reviewer can check.

expect.description: The expected value: string/number/bool/pattern per kind.

tolerance.description: Judged only: allowed mean drop from baseline before review.

history.description: Superseded expectations with dates+reasons — what the agent used to do, kept visible.
